title: ingest.object.deleted payload (v2, closed)
description: Payload of ingest.object.deleted. Producers: app/services/vault_sync.py::delete_note and the app/watcher/vault_watcher.py fallback (path/deleted/reason/source plus canonical uuid/object_id/vault_uuid); insert_object_and_outbox adds trace_id/event. Consumer app/workers/outbox_worker.py::handle_ingest_object_deleted resolves object_id (uuid fallback) to purge vectors, so at least one is required. Closed contract (#5704): undeclared top-level fields are rejected; producer extras belong under `extensions`. v1 stays registered for rows already tagged `ingest.object.deleted.v1`.

event_id.description: Envelope event id the worker run() loop copies into the payload before dispatch; carried onto retries.

_worker_retry_enqueued_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the worker retry enqueue.

extensions.description: The only open extension point: producer-specific extras must be nested here, never added as undeclared top-level fields.
